purpose: Give reviewers a safe, repeatable way to replay the agent against their own anonymized business-shaped CSV or read-only database data, then submit public evidence that can later upgrade resume outcomes.

replay_paths.command: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/business-data/agent-report -F file=@sample.csv -F dataset_name='Replay Dataset' -F owner='reviewer' -F primary_key='id' -F expected_columns='id,status,amount,created_at'
replay_paths.evidence_required: GitHub issue with dataset shape, command used, status, finding count, and redacted output summary

replay_paths.data_source: read-only PostgreSQL table or local compose table
replay_paths.evidence_required: GitHub issue confirming read-only run, table row count, selected tools, and report status

replay_paths.command: Open the business-case issue template and submit only anonymized context, tried path, outcome, and permission boundary.
replay_paths.data_source: anonymized description of a real workflow problem
replay_paths.evidence_required: Public business-case issue with business-case label and no raw customer data

resume_safe_summary: Published a CI-verified business-data replay packet with 3 safe replay paths, 8 evidence fields, 5 safety requirements, and zero current external replay claims.

resume_upgrade_rules.claim_when_met: at least one external reviewer replayed the agent on a business-shaped dataset
at least one anonymized real-world data-quality problem was reviewed publicly
at least one reproducible issue or missed quality rule was submitted publicly

safety_requirements: Use non-sensitive, anonymized, or synthetic-but-business-shaped data only.
Do not upload customer names, emails, addresses, tokens, secrets, or raw production exports.
Use read-only database credentials and bounded row limits.
Submit public evidence summaries, not raw data.
Mark whether the replay can be counted as feedback, confirmed run, reproducible issue, or business case.
